name: fix-init-agents-md
body: Amendment for agentic authoring. Source statement: `kalide init [path]` creates the deck's `slides/`, `assets/` and `kalide.yaml`; the no-arg form also writes the embedded hello seed. Inconsistency: the seed requirements described the deck tree but did not name the project-root agent guide now shipped with it. Resolution: requirements.requirement.cli-init and requirements.requirement.cli-init-minimal-seed now state that both deck forms write `AGENTS.md` (agent-authoring); the no-arg form carries it in the embedded seed tree copied by writeHelloSeed, and the external form reads the same embedded guide and writes it alongside kalide.yaml (no local templates/, no starter slide). Both forms write the SAME deck-author guide. [with user: locked decision 1; autonomous detail: shared guide]
